# Sample (Pickers)

Sample component

## Overview

- **Category**: pickers
- **Base Library**: custom

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { PickersSample } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<LocalizationProvider dateAdapter={AdapterDateFns}>
      <DatePicker label="Label" onChange={setValue} value={value} />
    </LocalizationProvider>
```

## Examples

```tsx

```
